title: What were 30 pieces of silver worth?

beats.text: Was thirty pieces of silver cheap?
beats.scene: Painted close-up of thirty silver coins spilling from a leather pouch onto a stone table in torchlight. Overlay: counter 30.

beats.text: Matthew says Judas took thirty pieces of silver.
beats.scene: Hooded man's hand receiving a pouch in a dim Jerusalem courtyard at night. Overlay: counter 30 coins.

beats.text: Probably Tyrian shekels, heavy coins of nearly pure silver.
beats.scene: Macro of a single ancient silver coin with a worn eagle, lit from the side. Overlay: weight badge about 14 g.

beats.text: Thirty of them weigh about four hundred twenty grams.
beats.scene: Pile of silver coins on an old brass balance scale. Overlay: weight counter 420 g.

beats.text: A labourer earned one denarius a day. Thirty shekels is about four months of pay.
beats.scene: Labourer hauling stones in a sunlit field. Overlay: calendar bar filling to 4 months.

beats.text: Take your own monthly pay. Multiply it by four.
beats.scene: Close-up of a worker's cracked hands counting coins at dusk. Overlay: counter x4.

beats.text: Judas sold a friend for four months of work.
beats.scene: Man walking away from a lamplit house into the night clutching a pouch. Overlay: calendar bar 4 months.

beats.text: Exodus 21:32 sets the same price for a slave gored by an ox.
beats.scene: Ox in a field at golden hour, farmer standing behind it. Overlay: counter 30 shekels.

beats.text: Zechariah 11:12 calls it a lordly price, with heavy irony.
beats.scene: Prophet holding silver coins in an open palm in harsh sunset light. Overlay: counter 30 shekels.

beats.text: The money bought a potter's field.
beats.scene: Dusty clay field with a potter's kiln at dusk, camera drifting forward. Overlay: coin counter dropping to 0.

beats.text: Not proven: Matthew never names the coin.
beats.scene: Single silver coin on dark stone beside a question-shaped shadow, soft light. Overlay: question mark badge.

beats.text: So was thirty pieces cheap? Insult, or real money?
beats.scene: Thirty coins glinting in a pouch at dusk, slow push in. Overlay: choice tags A insult / B real money.

youtube.title: What Were 30 Pieces of Silver Worth? #shorts
youtube.description:
Judas was paid thirty pieces of silver. What was that really worth? We check Exodus, Zechariah and Matthew.
The exact coin is not proven; the Tyrian shekel is only the likely candidate.
#Judas #Bible #Matthew #BibleHistory
